scope.name: Accessibility, Onboarding, Physical Output, and Event Modes
scope.responsibility: Converge accessibility controls, progressive information density, new-player/new-GM guidance, quickstarts, role-appropriate mobile companion flows, print/physical outputs, convention/one-shot/pickup modes, spectator/stream-safe views, and campaign/co-GM handoff.
exit_criteria: New players and GMs can enter without expert knowledge of Multiversal.
Physical, mobile, convention, spectator, and accessibility-dependent use are first-class workflows.
Information density can be reduced for accessibility/mobile/actionability without changing canonical meaning.
Event/temporary play can convert cleanly into persistent campaigns when desired.

next_action: MTLC-14 selected_not_started; later owner execution required. GPR PCV-03F remains independent.

completion_evidence.scope: Current-subject accessible display preferences, player/GM quickstarts and contextual help, task-focused/mobile navigation, role-filtered dated physical packs, explicitly published safe spectator cards, bounded convention/one-shot/pickup planning, current-participant consent graduation and acknowledged handoff to existing Campaign GMs.
completion_evidence.limitations: Source/runtime and cross-platform proof does not certify installed Windows/Android golden lifecycle, human assistive-technology usability or owner-approved measured friction budgets; those remain MTLC-14. Spectator access requires authenticated current Campaign participation. Dated print/text copies cannot retract later revocations. Handoff notes do not transfer ownership or grant roles/delegation. Public launch and commerce remain separately gated.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: New players and GMs can enter without expert knowledge of Multiversal.
acceptance_evidence.evidence: Player and GM quickstarts work before Group selection, explain each step in plain language, search/restore/dismiss help and open the actual people/Campaign/safety/preparation/play/continuity workspaces. Guide selection never grants authority or claims readiness.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: Physical, mobile, convention, spectator, and accessibility-dependent use are first-class workflows.
acceptance_evidence.evidence: Responsive one-column task navigation, native labeled keyboard/screen-reader controls, visible focus/skip links, 44px mobile controls, contrast/motion/text preferences, role-filtered print/text packs, explicit spectator cards, convention/one-shot/pickup planning and consented current-role GM handoff are implemented in the real shared service and PCV composition.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: Information density can be reduced for accessibility/mobile/actionability without changing canonical meaning.
acceptance_evidence.evidence: Personal Essential/Standard/Full presentation and 100/150/200 percent text preferences persist per current A3 subject. Task projection changes presentation only; current A5/Group owners still enforce access, actions, characters and canonical gameplay. Safe display/print replaces the private subtree and serializes explicit fields only.

acceptance_evidence.criterion: Event/temporary play can convert cleanly into persistent campaigns when desired.
acceptance_evidence.evidence: One-shot graduation requires all current participating A5 players/GM consent bound to the unchanged event plan and roster/permission fingerprint, rechecks organizer/Campaign authority and updates only the same existing Group-Campaign relationship. Withdrawal and plan/roster changes invalidate consent; idempotent retry creates no seat or second history. Trial links retain MTLC-12 mutual-trial decisions.
